description: Monarch Money CLI: agent-native access to accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, and cashflow with a local SQLite store and offline analytics.

novel_features.name: Bulk Categorize with Rule Generation
novel_features.description: Match transactions by merchant pattern + amount, apply a category, optionally promote the predicate to a server-side rule, and backfill historical matches in one call.

novel_features.name: Net-Worth Delta Attribution
novel_features.description: Decompose the net-worth change over a window into income, spending, market gain/loss, and transfers — the four numbers Monarch's chart hides behind a single line.

novel_features.name: Subscription Price-Drift Detector
novel_features.description: Detect recurring streams whose latest charge deviates from the trailing 6-month median by more than a threshold (default 5%).

novel_features.name: Budget Burn Rate
novel_features.description: For each active budget, compute spend-per-day vs allocation-per-day, project month-end position, and flag categories on track to overshoot.

novel_features.name: Stale-Account Watch
novel_features.description: Surface accounts whose last_synced is past a threshold, grouped by institution, with severity sorted by financial impact (big-balance accounts first).

novel_features.name: Cashflow Forecast
novel_features.description: Walk current balances forward N days through scheduled recurring streams and a trailing-90-day average of non-recurring outflow; emit per-day projected balance.

novel_features.name: Category Leak Detection
novel_features.description: Find merchants whose transactions split across 3+ categories (likely miscategorized) and Uncategorized merchants with prior labeled history.

novel_features.name: Agent Context Bundle
novel_features.description: Emit one JSON blob composed of net-worth-by-type, MTD cashflow, top-10 categories, active budget burn, next-7-day recurring, and last-7-day transactions — shaped for LLM consumption.

novel_features.name: Goal Pacing
novel_features.description: Compute trailing-90-day contribution velocity per goal and project completion date vs target.

novel_features.name: Categorize Next
novel_features.description: Emit the oldest Uncategorized transaction with a deterministic top-1 category suggestion derived from the local merchant×category histogram. No LLM.

novel_features.name: Monthly Reconciliation Memo
novel_features.description: Aggregate one month's transactions, budgets, net-worth-snapshots, and recurring data into a structured packet (top categories, MoM deltas, budget hits/misses, biggest charges, NW delta) ready for an LLM narrative draft.
